day3_lunch_start.name: Me
day3_lunch_start.text: *The lunch bell rings. It's Friday. Weekend starts tomorrow.*

day3_lunch_check_dates.name: Me
day3_lunch_check_dates.text: *As I stand up from my desk, I can feel eyes on me from every direction.*

day3_lunch_multiple_approach.name: Me
day3_lunch_multiple_approach.text: *...Why is everyone heading this way at the same time?*

day3_lunch_collision_no_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_lunch_collision_no_seoyeon.text: *The people I made plans with are all approaching at once. The vibe is not great.*

day3_lunch_tension_1.name: Me
day3_lunch_tension_1.text: *The classroom temperature just dropped about three degrees. Their gazes are crossing each other like blades.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_others_react.name: Me
day3_lunch_seoyeon_others_react.text: *I can feel the others' expressions harden.*

day3_lunch_yuna_jealous_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_jealous_2.text: *Yuna leaves the classroom without a word. Her retreating figure looks smaller than usual.*

day3_lunch_dain_jealous_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_dain_jealous_2.text: *Dain sticks out her lip and heads off the other way.*

day3_lunch_with_seoyeon_start.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_with_seoyeon_start.text: "...Finally, just us two. {name}, I'll be straight with you. Don't you think there are way too many people hanging around you lately?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_jealous_talk.name: Me
choices: "You're the one who matters most to me."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_reassure.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_reassure.text: "...I'm holding you to that. Take it back and there will be consequences."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_deny.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_deny.text: "...Right. Of course. Sorry, that was weird of me."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_tease.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_tease.text: "Jealous? ...Yeah, I am. Every time your attention drifts somewhere else, it burns. So just look at me."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_weekend.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_weekend.text: "Anyway, what are you doing this weekend? If you're free... want to go somewhere together?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_caught.name: Me
day3_lunch_seoyeon_caught.text: *Wait, I have other plans... what do I do?*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_dodge.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_dodge.text: "Why can't you answer? ...You have other plans, don't you?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_end.name: Me
day3_lunch_seoyeon_end.text: *After lunch, we sat side by side on a bench behind the school. A gentle breeze drifts by.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench.text: *Quietly resting her head on my shoulder* "...{name}. I've been a little off lately. I keep thinking about you."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench_2.text: *A faint fragrance drifts from Seoyeon's hair.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_pat.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_pat.text: *As I stroke her hair, Seoyeon buries her face in my shoulder* "...Idiot. Not here, people could see."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_same.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_same.text: *Seoyeon lifts her head and looks at me* "...Really? Don't you ever forget those words."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_silent.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_seoyeon_silent.text: *Seoyeon quietly takes my hand* "...I like it when we're like this."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Me
day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *Sitting side by side on the bench behind the school, talking with Seoyeon.*
day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.context: Sitting together on a bench behind the school. Seoyeon rested her head on his shoulder and said 'I keep thinking about you.' A sweet atmosphere.
day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool-beauty type. Sharp-tongued, composed, with a sly charm. She's possessive and bluntly direct when jealous.

day3_lunch_seoyeon_bell.name: Me
day3_lunch_seoyeon_bell.text: *The class bell rings. Time with Seoyeon felt way too short.*

day3_lunch_yuna_rooftop.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_rooftop.text: *I followed Yuna up to the rooftop. She lays out a blanket and pulls a lunchbox from her bag.*

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_2.text: *Two compartments of food sit neatly side by side. She clearly put care into this.*

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_ask.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_ask.text: *Looking away* "...Perceptive, aren't you. If it's bad, you can throw it out."

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_taste.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_taste.text: *I take a bite. Surprisingly... it's actually really good.*

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_eat.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_eat.text: *Watching me eat in silence, then the faintest smile* "...Is it good?"

day3_lunch_yuna_lap.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_lap.text: *After finishing the meal, a lazy breeze makes me drowsy. Yuna suddenly presses down on my shoulder.*

day3_lunch_yuna_lap_yes.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_lap_yes.text: *As I lie down, Yuna strokes my hair* "...Five minutes."

day3_lunch_yuna_lap_talk.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_lap_talk.text: *Stroking my hair softly* "...When we're like this, it feels like you're mine."

day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.text: *Lying on Yuna's lap on the rooftop, looking up at the sky and talking.*
day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.context: Lying on Yuna's lap on the rooftop. Yuna made a lunchbox for two and is stroking his hair. A quiet, peaceful atmosphere.
day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is languid, blunt, and marches to her own beat. She speaks in short, cryptic sentences. Cold on the surface, but there's a gap when she opens up.

day3_lunch_yuna_talk_1_jealous.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_talk_1_jealous.text: "...{name}. I thought you were only nice to me."

day3_lunch_yuna_single_end.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_single_end.text: *I spent a peaceful lunch hour with Yuna.*

day3_lunch_yuna_talk_2.name: Me
choices: "I want to be good to everyone."

day3_lunch_yuna_question.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_question.text: "...You don't need to know. Not yet."

day3_lunch_yuna_warning.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_yuna_warning.text: "Just remember one thing. Betray me... and you'll regret it."

day3_lunch_yuna_warning_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_yuna_warning_2.text: *Yuna's eyes flash with something chilling for an instant... She's joking, right?*

day3_lunch_with_dain_start.name: Dain
day3_lunch_with_dain_start.text: "Woohoo! {name}'s the best!! Let's hurry, they're serving chicken today!!"

day3_lunch_dain_talk_1.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_talk_1.text: "Hey, but... did you see Seoyeon's face just now? Total jealousy mode, right?"

day3_lunch_dain_talk_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_dain_talk_2.text: *Dain keeps glancing around and lowers her voice.*

day3_lunch_dain_talk_3.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_talk_3.text: "Be real with me. Are you dating Seoyeon? Or Yuna? I can tell they're both into you, you know."

day3_lunch_dain_confess.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_confess.text: "Wh-what?! You can't just say that out of nowhere...! Ugh, seriously!!"

day3_lunch_dain_friends.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_friends.text: "Hmm~ really? Their faces say otherwise though... whatever, not my business!"

day3_lunch_dain_jealous_tease.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_jealous_tease.text: "Huh?! Who's jealous?! I'm just curious!! ...Okay, maybe it bugs me a little!!"

day3_lunch_dain_serious.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_serious.text: *Suddenly stops her chopsticks and goes quiet* "...{name}. I need to ask you something. Seriously."

day3_lunch_dain_serious_2.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_serious_2.text: "...What am I to you? Just a friend? Or... something more?"

day3_lunch_dain_serious_choice.name: Me
day3_lunch_dain_serious_choice.text: *Dain's eyes are different from usual. She's dead serious.*

day3_lunch_dain_special.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_special.text: *Face turning crimson, she punches my shoulder* "H-hey!! Really?! I thought my heart was gonna explode!!"

day3_lunch_dain_unsure.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_unsure.text: *Her face falls for a second, then immediately brightens* "...Alright! Then just watch me become special!!"

day3_lunch_dain_friend.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_friend.text: *Dain's expression freezes for a moment, then she forces a smile* "...Oh? Friend. Right, of course we're friends. Haha."

day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.name: Me
day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting side by side with Dain in the cafeteria, talking.*
day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.context: Having lunch with Dain. She asked 'what am I to you?' with a serious face. She's being shy instead of her usual energetic self.
day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is a puppy-energy type who loves physical contact and is fiercely competitive. Exclamation mark machine. Tsundere. Upbeat on the outside, sensitive on the inside.

day3_lunch_dain_end.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_end.text: "Anyway! You're coming to watch my practice tomorrow, right?! You HAVE to come!!"

day3_lunch_dain_conflict.name: Me
day3_lunch_dain_conflict.text: *Tomorrow... I have other plans too, though.*

day3_lunch_dain_maybe.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_maybe.text: "...If you have time? Do you have other plans?"

day3_lunch_dain_suspicious.name: Dain
day3_lunch_dain_suspicious.text: "Hmph! Fine. But if you bail on me, I'm seriously getting mad, okay?!"

day3_lunch_together_react.name: Me
day3_lunch_together_react.text: *Silence. Three pairs of eyes scan each other.*

day3_lunch_together_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_together_2.text: *The cafeteria. The atmosphere is strangely hostile.*

day3_lunch_together_3.name: Dain
day3_lunch_together_3.text: "{name}! You're coming to watch volleyball practice tomorrow, right?!"

day3_lunch_together_4.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_together_4.text: "Huh? {name} already has plans with me tomorrow."

day3_lunch_together_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_together_yuna.text: "...{name} made plans with me. Tomorrow night."

day3_lunch_together_explosion.name: Me
day3_lunch_together_explosion.text: *The air freezes over in an instant. Every pair of eyes locks onto me.*

day3_lunch_together_silence.name: Me
day3_lunch_together_silence.text: *A suffocating silence. Seoyeon's hand is trembling, Yuna's eyes have gone dark, and Dain's expression has turned to stone.*

day3_lunch_together_seoyeon_react.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_together_seoyeon_react.text: *Slowly sets down her spoon* "...So I wasn't the only special one."

day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie.text: *Standing up* "...I already knew. That {name} didn't only make promises to me."

day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_2.name: Dain
day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_2.text: "...Really? Then why did you come here knowing that?"

day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_3.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_3.text: *Looking over coldly* "...That was a lie. I had no idea. I just... didn't want to cry in front of everyone."

day3_lunch_together_confront.name: Seoyeon
day3_lunch_together_confront.text: "Wait. {name}, did you make promises to all of us?"
choices: Say the time slots are different

day3_lunch_apologize.name: Me
day3_lunch_apologize.text: "I'm sorry... I just couldn't say no to any of you."

day3_lunch_apologize_react.name: Dain
day3_lunch_apologize_react.text: "...I appreciate the honesty, but that still ticks me off."

day3_lunch_excuse.name: Me
day3_lunch_excuse.text: "The time slots are all different... Dain's is in the morning, the others are in the afternoon..."

day3_lunch_excuse_react_2.name: Dain
day3_lunch_excuse_react_2.text: "Hmm... if you manage your time well, it's fine, right? I don't mind."

day3_lunch_excuse_react_3.name: Yuna
day3_lunch_excuse_react_3.text: "...That works for someone like you, maybe. I'm... *stands up* leaving."

day3_lunch_run.name: Me
day3_lunch_run.text: *I shove my food down and flee the scene. That was the worst possible choice.*

day3_lunch_together_end.name: Me
day3_lunch_together_end.text: *Lunch ended in an awkward haze. The weekend is terrifying...*

day3_lunch_escape.name: Me
day3_lunch_escape.text: "Oh, I just remembered something! Gotta go!"

day3_lunch_escape_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_escape_2.text: *I slip out like a fugitive. Overlapping sighs trail behind me.*

day3_lunch_nurse.name: Me
day3_lunch_nurse.text: *I headed to the nurse's office. She's eating a sandwich.*

day3_lunch_nurse_2.name: Nurse
day3_lunch_nurse_2.text: *She sees me and smiles* "Oh my, {name}! Have you eaten? Want to join me?"

day3_lunch_nurse_3.name: Nurse
day3_lunch_nurse_3.text: *Locking the door* "We need our private time, don't we? I'm tired of looking over my shoulder."

day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.name: Me
day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.text: *Having lunch with the Nurse, just the two of us in the nurse's office.*
day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.context: Having lunch alone with the Nurse in the nurse's office. She locked the door. It feels like a secret date.
day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.personality: The Nurse is playful, alluring, and mature. She's torn between her feelings for the student and her ethics as a teacher.

day3_lunch_nurse_4.name: Nurse
day3_lunch_nurse_4.text: *Glancing at the clock with a sigh* "...Time's up. Get back to class. See you Sunday."

day3_lunch_teacher.name: Me
day3_lunch_teacher.text: *I went to the teachers' office. She's sitting alone, drinking coffee.*

day3_lunch_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day3_lunch_teacher_2.text: *She looks startled to see me, then brightens* "{name}? What brings you here? It's my lunch break..."

day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.name: Me
day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.text: *Having lunch with Teacher, just the two of us in the teachers' office.*
day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.context: Having lunch alone with Teacher in the teachers' office. She blushed and closed the door.
day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.personality: Teacher has a dry sense of humor. Seems blunt on the surface, but there's a gap when she catches herself having feelings for a student.

day3_lunch_teacher_4.name: Teacher
day3_lunch_teacher_4.text: *Setting down her coffee cup* "...This isn't right. A student coming to spend lunch with me, and me being happy about it. Is this normal?"

day3_lunch_normal.name: Me
day3_lunch_normal.text: *No special plans or anything... just a normal lunch.*

day3_lunch_normal_2.name: Me
day3_lunch_normal_2.text: *Laughter drifts from nearby. Everyone else seems to be having a good time.*

day3_lunch_alone.name: Me
day3_lunch_alone.text: *I ate lunch quietly by myself. What should I do this weekend?*
